tasks.label: Start local web server
args: $port = 8000; $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.State -eq 'Listen' }; if (-not $listener) { Start-Process py -ArgumentList '-m','http.server','8000','--bind','127.0.0.1' -WindowStyle Hidden }
